title: Research quality evaluator v2 with semantic and RAG metrics v0
problem: Blocked by ticket-426. The current evaluator can reward accepted-row ratios and graph counts even when accepted claims are poor. Product and self-improvement verdicts must be based on research-quality, admission, corroboration, reviewed-live-proof, retrieval, citation, and abstention metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluator v2 consumes source contamination, claim precision/recall, false acceptance, provenance completeness, unresolved review, independent corroboration, graph integrity, retrieval, citation, unsupported-sentence, and abstention metrics.
Legacy row counts and acceptance ratios remain diagnostic but cannot independently produce a research or RAG GO verdict.
Missing, stale, mock-only, or unreviewed live artifacts are explicit and prevent claims of live arbitrary-source GO.
Operator plan and self-improvement status explain the exact failing metric, threshold, observed value, artifact path, and safe next action.
A seeded fixture with many accepted junk claims receives NO-GO even when graph counts and acceptance ratio are high.
Engine-contract, research-quality, and RAG-quality verdicts are separate fields and cannot be conflated in README or artifacts.
On completion, ticket-428 changes from blocked to ready.
test_plan: With mock-only env: python -m pytest tests/golden -q
With mock-only env: python -m rge.cli verify --skip-site
non_goals: Do not remove useful operational count metrics.
Do not average a critical safety or false-acceptance failure into a passing composite score.
Do not auto-run live proofs or paid providers.
Do not generate or promote implementation tickets in this ticket.
rollback_plan: Restore evaluator v1 as a legacy diagnostic while labeling its verdict non-authoritative. Retain v2 artifacts and do not relabel failed research runs as GO.
